name: ITH Center Data Center Mayotte (Information Technology Hosting SAS)
notes: Mayotte's only public colocation/hosting data center, at Zone Industrielle de Kaweni, Mamoudzou; inaugurated 2022-10-21 with AFD financing (EUR 3M of ~EUR 10M total investment; Banque des Territoires 1.3M EUR equity + AFD/Credit Agricole Reunion-Mayotte ~7.5M EUR loans). AFD official project page/PDF (checked 2026-08-12) confirms 'construction et exploitation du premier data center de Mayotte' and describes ITH as first TIER III data center in Mayotte 'tel que defini par l'Uptime Institute' - record as tier_claim only, no Uptime/TIA/EPI certificate ID found in registries, so not 'certified Tier III'. Capacity per AFD = 420 kW / 76 IT bays + 2 private suites of 8 bays (capacity_mw=0.42, A-grade); ITH official site claims 80 colocation bays (A-grade operator source); DataCenterMap lists 0.65 MW / 350 sqm at 629 Bd. Younoussa Bamana, BP 376, 97600 Mamoudzou (C-grade alt, not overriding). Invest In Mayotte (official investment agency) confirms 80 bays, Tier III standards, 99.982% availability. Mayotte Hebdo (2025-2026) calls it 'l'unique data center de Mayotte' - no other DC found. Cyclone Chido (Dec 2024) test passed with interior undamaged and operations continuing (Mayotte la 1ere). Connectivity-only (not DCs per methodology): MAYOTIX IXP at Mamoudzou Vice-Rectorate (RENATER), LION2 / FLY-LION3 / Avassa cable landings at Kaweni/Mamoudzou, EDM Longoni power plant. No AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI Mayotte region/local zone on official region lists (A-grade negative).
tier_claim: Tier III / conception Tier III (as defined by Uptime Institute per AFD; not certified - no certificate ID found)
